annotations.title: E-mail address check: syntax, MX, disposable, role, free provider, typos

description: E-mail address check: syntax, MX, disposable, role, free provider, typos. Validates an address without sending mail: RFC syntax, normalized IDN domain, MX (or implicit A) records, null-MX, disposable-domain list, role accounts (info@, admin@), free providers and typo suggestions (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Verdict: deliverable, risky, undeliverable or invalid. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
